versions.short: The bill would direct the Secretary of Energy to transfer the former Moab uranium mill site in Utah to Grand County at no cost once cleanup reaches a stage suitable for land transfer, with the government keeping water rights needed for ongoing responsibilities and barring the county from passing the land to private or nonprofit owners. It would also require the Secretary to give the Grand County Water Conservancy District, at no cost, a water pipeline, pumps, easements, a holding pond, and a water right tied to the same cleanup, on the condition that the district use them to address local water shortages and not pass them to private or nonprofit owners.
